- **Ticket:** `docs/tickets/090_S5.8__surface-ecosystem-and-compat.md`

## Gap analysis (existing seams vs ticket scope)

S5.8 lands the compatibility machinery at contract major 1 plus the
`R-2.2.5²`/`R-2.2.3²` extension legs. Every new behaviour rides
`hh-embed/1` or the declared provider/driver contracts — no second
schema, no surface-side recomputation:

| AC/leg | Landed | Where |
|---|---|---|
| Deprecation machinery (§7.4 rule 5; ADR-0178 D5) | `OpDeprecation` + `OpSpec.deprecated`; the stability map and schema export emit the member; dispatch mints durable `lifecycle.contract.deprecated_use{method, client}` under the session lease (contract-run fallback when sessionless); `Store::deprecated_uses` folds `(method, client) → count` as a rebuildable projection | `crates/hh-embed-schema/src/ops.rs` · `crates/hh-embed/src/service.rs` · `crates/hh-ledger/src/store.rs` · `hh-ledger/tests/s5_8.rs` · `hh-embed` service units |
| Compatibility matrix (ADR-0178 D8) | `schema/compat-1.matrix.json` generated from the schema source by `hh-codegen`; `check-drift.sh` drift-checks it alongside the schema export + generated client (CC7). Two entries at major 1: current `ok`, retired `kernel_newer → schema_mismatch` | `crates/hh-codegen/src/main.rs` · `scripts/check-drift.sh` · `schema/compat-1.matrix.json` |
| Surface inventory + OQ-130 (AC-R-2.11.4-11) | `hh-kernel/tests/surface_inventory.rs` scans every method-position literal in `hh-cli`/`hh-web`/`hh-mcp-lab`/`hh-acp` `src/` — each names a registered op or expands under a registered namespace; the committed report lists ops + tiers per surface and records the unfired trigger 6 | `crates/hh-kernel/tests/surface_inventory.rs` · `docs/build/reports/S5.8-surface-inventory.md` |
| `memory` snapshots (R-2.2.5²) | `env.snapshot{kind}` accepts `memory` through the provider adapter on a quiesced/suspended handle; undeclared kinds answer `unknown` (tri-state, never a guess) | `crates/hh-env/src/{driver,provider}.rs` · `hh-env/tests/s5_8.rs` |
| `restore_in_place` | Declared driver/provider capability — typed refusal when undeclared; heal/replace prefers a memory snapshot (snapshot-first: the restore image is on record before replacement) | `crates/hh-env/src/{driver,provider,recovery}.rs` · `s5_8::{restore_in_place_*, heal_replace_prefers_memory_snapshot}` |
| Hibernation (R-2.2.3² lease leg) | `env.suspend{on_idle:"hibernate"}` takes the memory snapshot inside the suspend batch — suspension + restore image are one durable act; suspended runs stay exempt from liveness takeover (ADR-0131 §4, existing battery) | `crates/hh-env/src/driver.rs` · `s5_8::hibernate_*` · `durable_execution::ac_2_2_3_5_*` |
| Attested microVM images | `EnvironmentRecord` carries the image-attestation pairing validated at resolve; containment backends stay fail-closed (`user_space_kernel`/`microvm` require `substrate_attestation`; foreign digests/tags never claim `attested`) | `crates/hh-env/src/record.rs` · `s5_8::attested_microvm_image_verified_at_resolve` |
| `control.wakeup.*` → MCP tasks/push (R-2.2.3²; ADR-0175 D3) | `EmbedService::deliver_due_wakeups` — the kernel-internal trigger pass: durable `control.wakeup.occurred`/`fired` before any delivery, `(subscription, occurrence)` dedup via the session's `delivered_wokens`; the tasks carrier drains due wakeups per call and pushes narrowed `notifications/tasks{taskId}` (client re-reads `tasks/get`); no `capabilities.tasks` ⇒ no push; a provably-gone writer re-attaches `resume{mode:"takeover", cause:"wakeup"}` once | `crates/hh-embed/src/durability_ops.rs` · `crates/hh-mcp-lab/src/{tasks,resources,launch,server}.rs` · `hh-mcp-lab/tests/s5_8.rs` |
| Hosted `resume` mapping (AC-R-2.2.3-13) | `OpenSpec::Resume` gains optional `cause` (closed set); the ACP driver's dead-writer resume scans the durable tail through a read-only attach and declares `wakeup` only when an awaiting-*/`hibernated` suspension is followed by `control.wakeup.fired` — else `operator`; a live writer keeps pure replay | `crates/hh-embed-schema/src/types.rs` · `crates/hh-acp/src/embed.rs` (+3 unit tests) · `hh-embed/tests/s5_8.rs::resume_cause_mints_run_resumed` |

## Decisions

See **ADR-0319** — deprecation declared-on-op / counted-at-dispatch /
folded-in-ledger (D1), the generated compatibility matrix (D2), the
compile-time OQ-130 inventory (D3), `memory` as a declared snapshot
kind with hibernation in the suspend batch (D4), `restore_in_place`
as a declared driver capability (D5), the attestation pairing on
`EnvironmentRecord` (D6), the durable-first wakeup→tasks lowering
(D7), and the record-read resume `cause` (D8).

## In-run fixes worth recording

- **`resources.rs` delimiter repair** — the notification block's
  `Json::obj` nesting was corrected, then the missing
  `tasks::{push_for_runs, drain_due_wakeups}` helpers landed.
- **`attach_take_over` shape** — the stale-writer recovery sends
  `kind:"resume", mode:"takeover"` (attach is read-only and takes no
  `mode`); `attach_take_over_caused` carries the optional `cause`.
- **`EmbedError` import** — exported from `hh_embed_schema`, not
  `hh_embed`.
- **S5.8 embed-test fixture** — the wakeup subscription is an
  experimental op (hello `experimental: true`), and writer-lease
  takeover is *expiry*-disciplined (never liveness-probe — that
  shortening is scoped-lease only, ADR-0130): the resume fixture runs
  both service instances over `ManualClock` and steps past the 120 s
  TTL.
- **`EnvironmentRecord` field placement** — the `image_attestation`
  member was inserted inside the struct literals across the seven
  existing test files that construct it (`None` for pre-S5.8 legs).
- **The edit-tool stale-view anomaly recurred** on
  `surface_inventory.rs` (the known overlay divergence) — the clippy
  fixes were applied via shell and verified by direct byte
  inspection.
- **Pre-existing clippy** — `hh-bench::benchset::load_task` trips
  `too_many_arguments` under this toolchain on untouched code;
  recorded, not fixed (S5.7's convention).
